parsed.name: 单色仪
parsed.description: 用于将复色光按波长分散并选出窄带光的光学单色仪。该设备通常包含光栅转塔、狭缝、滤光轮、反射镜和快门，可在光谱测量与其他光学实验中进行波长扫描、带宽调节和光路切换。
parsed.description_en: An optical monochromator that disperses polychromatic light and selects a narrow wavelength band. The device typically includes a grating turret, slits, filter wheels, mirrors, and shutters, and is used in spectroscopy and other optical experiments for wavelength scanning, bandwidth adjustment, and beam-path selection.
